statement: WarpCombustor extracts computational planes from the structured dataset and warps them using scalar values along local normals as a velocity-profile visualization.
CombustorIsosurface generates an isosurface of constant flow density from combxyz.bin and combq.bin.
The VTK Book’s combustion-chamber example uses this dataset to visualize constant flow-density surfaces, supporting stored density as a dataset-specific observable for density-feature construction.
The Combustor isosurface example supports reporting the identity, representative location, and surface extent of a selected constant-density structure; exact benchmark values come from execution.
